findings.title: Production application deploys have no working manual-approval gate
findings.note: still operator-gated at 6b7aa1a: every prod-mutating job attaches prod-approval (deploy-do.yml:648, supabase-migrations.yml:38, terraform-do.yml:204, load-test.yml, db-backup.yml/db-restore-test.yml, alert-path-exercise.yml), but docs still state the required reviewers are not configured (docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:9-16, docs/RELEASING.md:141-149). The repo cannot set environment reviewers.

findings.title: Branch-protection-as-code has a likely-mismatched required check and permits admin bypass
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: reproduced the guard - node scripts/check-required-checks.mjs PASS, all 8 main / 6 develop contexts resolve to emitted check-runs (incl. 'Dependency Review / review' <- dependency-review.yml job review); enforce_admins:true + require_code_owner_reviews:true in both payloads; guard + fixtures wired in the required test job (unit-tests action.yml:136-144).

findings.title: Production deploy path cannot run; prod environment lacks secrets and protection rules
findings.note: still operator-gated at 6b7aa1a: docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:187-224 and docs/RELEASING.md:188-199 state prod-approval lacks SUPABASE_*/JWT_SECRET/migration secrets, DO_API_TOKEN returns 401, and prod has no DROPLET_IP fallback. No repo-side change.

findings.title: NEW: published fast-mode audit run fails the docs-links gate on main (required check + deploy gate red)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: node scripts/check-docs-links.mjs exits 0. The fast-run 905ed63 directory is indexed (docs/audits/README.md:113) and carries HISTORICAL.md; the new 20261103-0748 run is also indexed. The script runs in the required Test / test (20.x) job (unit-tests action.yml:72-74).

findings.title: World-open DigitalOcean firewall mutation with no approval and unvalidated udp_port
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: no firewall/wireguard workflow exists in .github/workflows (30 workflows inventoried); terraform-do rejects empty/world-open ADMIN_IP_RANGES before plan/apply (terraform-do.yml:102-113, :241-248).

findings.title: Deploy-gate secret scan is a no-op on pushes to main
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: secret-scan composite diffs against github.event.before with a zero-SHA -> HEAD~1 fallback (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:15-28); used by test.yml:78-88 and validate.yml:98-108.

findings.title: Production approval environment documented as having no required reviewers
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: docs state the truth (matrix:12-14, RELEASING.md:128-133); the operational gap is tracked by CI-P1-001/003.

findings.title: DB restore test reports success without asserting restore integrity
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: db-restore-test.yml:196-330 fails on table/migration/row/freshness/RLS floors (psql counts + created_at age + rowsecurity), not just prints.

findings.title: Infrastructure changes are no longer gated in CI (terraform-do is manual-dispatch only)
findings.note: terraform-do.yml remains manual-dispatch only (header :4-8) at 6b7aa1a; a weekly plan-only drift run exists (:14-15) but stays dormant until the operator sets TF_DRIFT_PLAN_ENABLED=true (:40), and PR/push plan gating stays off pending DO token rotation + environment protection.

findings.title: Chromatic visual-regression job is permanently non-blocking
findings.note: at 6b7aa1a the job still has no continue-on-error and exitZeroOnChanges:false (chromatic.yml:28,98), so a broken Storybook build is blocking. Residual: the new token check (chromatic.yml:71-88) skips the Chromatic step entirely when CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN is unset; live run 41598762575 (6b7aa1a) shows step 8 'Chromatic' skipped and the job green, so visual diffs/axe are not gated until the token is provisioned (docs matrix:151 lists it as required).

findings.title: Branch protection permits admin bypass and ignores CODEOWNERS
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: both .github/branch-protection payloads set enforce_admins:true, require_code_owner_reviews:true, allow_force_pushes:false, allow_deletions:false, required_conversation_resolution:true.

findings.title: Terraform apply is manual and drift detection is not automated
findings.note: weekly plan-only drift check wired (terraform-do.yml:14-15, fails on non-empty plan :160-172) but dormant until TF_DRIFT_PLAN_ENABLED=true (:40); apply remains manual-dispatch + approval-gated.

findings.title: E2E is a required check on main but path-filtered, so PRs that miss its paths can never satisfy branch protection
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: e2e.yml pull_request has no paths filter (:19-23); check-required-checks.mjs fails if a required check's workflow is path-filtered (fixture-tested, scripts/ci/check-required-checks.sh PASS).

findings.title: Backup dispatcher duplicates the backup workflows now that they exist on the default branch
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: backup-dispatch.yml no longer exists anywhere in the tree; SCHEDULE_DISPATCH_TOKEN is documented as retired (matrix:160-162; SECRETS_ROTATION.md:98) and backup-staleness-check.yml now uses only GITHUB_TOKEN (:52). Residual stale comments still mention the retired dispatcher (backup-staleness-check.yml:17,61), but no workflow reads the PAT.

findings.title: actionlint/shellcheck workflow lint issues (SC2086/SC2129/SC2002/SC2015)
findings.note: shellcheck gate wired in both gates (test.yml:56, validate.yml:56; .github/actions/shellcheck/action.yml, --severity=warning) and the named issues are addressed; actionlint remains config-only (.github/actionlint.yaml) with no CI job.

findings.title: Over-broad workflow token permissions (unused write scopes)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: no 'actions: write' grants remain anywhere in .github/; workflow-level permissions are contents:read except codeql (security-events), dependency-review (pull-requests), release (contents), sbom/deploy builds (packages/id-token/attestations).

findings.title: StrictHostKeyChecking=no in the deploy health check
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: deploy-do.yml:1152 uses StrictHostKeyChecking=yes with a pinned known_hosts built from DO_SSH_HOST_KEY; alert-path-exercise.yml:111 and scripts/rollback.sh:61 the same (rollback requires an explicit last-resort opt-in for accept-new).

findings.title: `main` is far behind `develop`; scheduled jobs fire only from the default branch
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: origin/main contains all of origin/develop (git rev-list origin/main..origin/develop = 0; main is 7 ahead), so all 11 new scheduled workflows are on the default branch and their crons can fire. (This row was 'regressed' at 905ed63.)

findings.title: Secret scanner misses the platform's own token formats and scans diffs only
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the diff scanner reads the canonical scripts/ci/secret-patterns.txt list (secret-scan action.yml:14-16) which includes dop_v1_, sbp_, glpat-, sk-proj- and npm_ (:1-15), and `node scripts/ci/test-secret-patterns.mjs` passes (6 formats + 3 negatives). The pre-commit .sh/.ps1 scanners consume the same file.

findings.title: Unused permission grants across deploy/test workflows
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: security-events:write only in codeql.yml (which uploads SARIF); terraform-do has no pull-requests:write and no dead PR-comment step; remaining grants (dependency-review pull-requests, release contents, build packages/id-token/attestations) are all consumed.

findings.title: DB restore test uses an unpinned `postgres:16-alpine` image
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: db-restore-test.yml:177 postgres:16-alpine@sha256:721873c34ceb9f8d8fc265984940dc982404c105f19ad51be9fdc5970a6080ea.

findings.title: No release/tagging workflow and no post-merge release artifact
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: release.yml is wired (annotated tag + GitHub Release + lockfile SBOM) and live run 41598762576 succeeded; 36 tags exist and the latest Release (v0.1.0-20261103-6b7aa1a) has release-sbom.cdx.json attached. The post-merge release artifact is now delivered.

findings.title: e2e is required on `main` but the documented flakiness makes it an unstable hard gate
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: docs/CI.md:196-211 documents the retry budget 2 + flake summary + quarantine policy; scripts/e2e-flake-summary.mjs reports retries and retried tests do not fail the job. The current E2E outage is a separate release-blocking failure (CI-P1-005), not flakiness policy.

findings.title: Missing per-job timeouts and minor workflow hygiene gaps
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: every job that can carry timeout-minutes does (30-workflow inventory, none missing); reusable-workflow callers document the callee carrying its own.

findings.title: Workflow documentation drift: docs list a removed workflow, omit a live one, and misstate gate behavior
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the docs/CI.md File-column workflow inventory still matches all 30 .github/workflows files (0 missing/0 stale) and scripts/check-docs-links.mjs exits 0. Content-level row drift (Chromatic 'Failing', third-party 'four refs') is tracked in CI-P3-014 and INFRA-P2-003.

findings.title: Badge/report generation is a stub and is not wired into CI
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the badge stubs are gone (no generate_badges.py/history_logger.py under scripts/); docs/CI.md:213-226 documents the real reports (coverage-reports artifact, job summaries).

findings.title: workflow_dispatch inputs are interpolated directly into run: scripts (rollback_sha/deploy_target)
findings.note: fixed at 6b7aa1a (commit 07e9ce09, in main): deploy-do passes rollback_sha/deploy_target/ref through env indirection (ROLLBACK_SHA_INPUT :74-84, DEPLOY_TARGET_INPUT/REF_NAME_INPUT :88-91, ROLLBACK_SHA :482, SENTRY_RELEASE :666 env block). Remaining direct interpolations are type:choice inputs (load-test scenario :167) or env-block expressions, which GitHub validates server-side.

findings.title: NEW: Storybook webpack fix landed but CI docs/comments still describe the Chromatic build as broken
findings.note: at 6b7aa1a docs/CI.md and the chromatic.yml comments now describe the webpack 5.101.2 pin as applied, and the post-pin job builds Storybook. Residual: docs/testing.md:143-149 and docs/ui-kit.md:279-281 still say the Storybook build is broken/red, and docs/CI.md:19 still labels the Chromatic gate 'Failing (not required)' while live runs are green.

findings.title: release.yml fails on every promotion (SIGPIPE exit 141), so no tag/release/SBOM attachment is produced
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: release.yml now uses `git log --max-count=100` and a sed range instead of `| head` (release.yml:100-113) and sets the git identity before tagging (:147-148). Live run 41598762576 (6b7aa1a) is green; origin now carries 36 tags including v0.1.0-20261103-6b7aa1a and the GitHub Release has release-sbom.cdx.json attached.

findings.title: NEW: required E2E check is red at the promotion head (Start Supabase fails)
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a: the required E2E check is red at the promotion head. Live runs 41598757709 (PR #333 head 2a8b6ab), 41593286318, 41590405172 and 41569749520 all fail at step 10 'Start Supabase' after 'Restore the Supabase image cache' and 'Load the cached Supabase images' succeed; the last green run was 41520431521 (b2fd32a) at 2026-11-02T20:34Z. PR #333 was merged with the e2e check failed, and deploy-do run 41598762689 for 6b7aa1a is pending (on main the prod e2e-gate runs and will block). Root cause is not retrievable read-only (job logs need admin); the cache path is the newest variable (e2e.yml:82-105).

findings.title: NEW: declared Node engine floor (>=20.0.0) is below the >=20.11 required by import.meta.dirname
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a: package.json:7 declares node >=20.0.0, but scripts/ci/check-validate-sbom.mjs:25, scripts/ci/check-supply-chain-gates.mjs:31-32 and scripts/check-audits-budget.mjs:25 use import.meta.dirname, which requires Node >=20.11. Running check-validate-sbom.mjs on Node 18 fails with ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE; a developer on an allowed Node 20.0-20.10 would also fail. CI's setup-node 20.x resolves a newer 20, so live CI is unaffected.
